notebook: Turn 63, 48 solves used (this call may make 49). Best valid = 0.000 (empty). Team = 0.000. After ~48 solves I never reached a stream >=95% pure in this expensive scenario: every column cost $100-1500M/yr against zero revenue. Key barriers: (1) feed at 24 bar crushes relative volatility, so even large pressure drops (dp 0.85 -> ~3.6 bar) didn't yield the sharp cuts needed; (2) the required cuts are tight (e.g. n-hexane 341.9 vs methylcyclopentane 345 = 3.1K) and need many stages/high reflux, which is unaffordable; (3) side-draw purity is limited so middle cuts (C5mix, C6parmix) stayed below 95%. I'm locking in the guaranteed-valid empty design at 0.000 rather than risk spending the last solves on another failing cascade. Key target values if ever achievable: C6parmix 1181, C5mix 618, nC5 439 M$/yr.
